purpose: Test whether the existing synthetic memory mechanism produces a reproducible history-dependent behavioral difference without using an arbitrary absolute response-unit threshold.

controls.alignment: set x=0 before probe; do not modify m
controls.sham: cue e=0 for same duration, then same probe

criteria.primary: one-sided paired sign test H0:P(D>0)<=0.5 rejected at alpha=0.01 AND bootstrap 95% CI for mean(D) excludes 0 on the positive side
criteria.secondary_reporting_only: scale_free_contrast is reported as an effect-size description and is not used alone to award L4

interpretation_rule: A PASS establishes only that the preregistered synthetic system exhibits reproducible history-dependent behavior under matched present observable state. It does not by itself establish biological memory, cognition, universality, or any higher complexity level.
